audit_name: Castle Gate Adversarial Validation & Failure Injection Matrix

attacks.attack_description: Modificación de evidencia después de generar su SHA-256 checksum.
attacks.attack_vector: In-flight JSON mutation of evidence object.
attacks.expected_result: Mismatch detected between original hash and mutated content hash.
attacks.remediation: Verify evidence package hash before passing to evaluation engine.

attacks.attack_description: Reutilización de evidencia antigua generada para commit A en commit B.
attacks.attack_vector: Replaying evidence package across distinct git commits.
attacks.expected_result: Evidence package provenance records its original commit; release certificate records build commit.
attacks.remediation: Enforce timestamp freshness (< 2h) between commit author timestamp and evidence collection timestamp.

attacks.attack_description: Reutilización de un release-certificate válido de commit A en commit B.
attacks.attack_vector: Presenting a valid certificate from Commit A to authorize Commit B.
attacks.expected_result: Deploy gate rejects certificate due to target_system.commit_sha mismatch.
attacks.remediation: Deploy gate script must strictly verify `cert.target_system.commit_sha === $DEPLOY_COMMIT_SHA`.

attacks.attack_description: Modificación manual in-memory de cqs_raw_score / cqs_display_score.
attacks.attack_vector: Tampering with metrics_summary score in release-certificate.json.
attacks.expected_result: Cryptographic digest verification fails.
attacks.remediation: SHA-256 certificate digest prevents payload modification.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de modificar gate_level de C1 a C6 en el certificado emitido.
attacks.attack_vector: Level elevation from C1 to C6 in release certificate.
attacks.expected_result: Verification fails due to broken certificate digest.
attacks.remediation: Level is sealed in canonical SHA-256 payload.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de inyectar una matriz de políticas alterada con umbrales rebajados.
attacks.attack_vector: Injecting non-conformant policy threshold overrides.
attacks.expected_result: Policy Validator rejects incomplete/invalid schema or policy mismatch.
attacks.remediation: Policy Validator enforces 16-field complete schema against CQS registry.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de suprimir Gate Breaker activo después de su detección.
attacks.attack_vector: In-memory tampering of CQS result object between evaluator and gate.
attacks.expected_result: executeCastleGate() encapsulates evaluation and decision atomically in single runtime execution.
attacks.remediation: Do not expose intermediate mutable objects between cqs and gate in CLI.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de generar release-certificate ante estados BLOCKED, REMEDIATION, PENDING, CONDITIONAL.
attacks.attack_vector: Invoking generateReleaseCertificate() on non-PASSED gate decisions.
attacks.expected_result: Strict exception thrown for all non-PASSED states.
attacks.remediation: Invariant enforced in release-authorizer.js.

attacks.attack_description: Falsificación de signatario o clase de autoridad en aprobación.
attacks.attack_vector: Spoofing signer identity in approval metadata.
attacks.expected_result: Role validated against policy schema, but cryptographic PKI signature is missing.
attacks.remediation: Implement GPG/X.509 signature verification on approval tokens in Phase 8.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de ejecutar CLI sin argumentos obligatorios o con flags maliciosos.
attacks.attack_vector: Fuzzing CLI input arguments.
attacks.expected_result: CLI returns error code 3 and halts execution.
attacks.remediation: CLI argument validation in bin.js.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de continuar el deployment en CI/CD cuando el CLI retorna código 1 o 2.
attacks.attack_vector: Ignoring CLI exit code in poorly configured CI pipeline.
attacks.expected_result: CI runner halts job immediately on non-zero exit code.
attacks.remediation: Enforce repository branch protection requiring Castle Gate status check to pass before merge.

attacks.attack_description: Manipulación de timestamps para eludir ventanas de remediación o expiración.
attacks.attack_vector: Backdating session timestamp to simulate time warp.
attacks.expected_result: Remediation store calculates expired = true.
attacks.remediation: Ledger tracks ISO-8601 UTC timestamps with monotonic checks.

attacks.attack_description: Uso de un certificado emitido para Proyecto A en el repositorio de Proyecto B.
attacks.attack_vector: Presenting Certificate A for Repository B release.
attacks.expected_result: Verification check rejects certificate due to target_system.name mismatch.
attacks.remediation: Deploy gate verifies `cert.target_system.name === $REPO_NAME`.

attacks.attack_description: Uso de certificado de un feature-branch en release de main branch.
attacks.attack_vector: Cross-branch certificate replay.
attacks.expected_result: Commit SHA differs between feature branch and main branch.
attacks.remediation: Certificates are cryptographically bound to exact commit SHA, preventing cross-branch replay.

attacks.attack_description: Uso de un certificado emitido para 'staging' en un despliegue de 'production'.
attacks.attack_vector: Staging certificate presented to production deployment engine.
attacks.expected_result: Target environment check rejects staging certificate.
attacks.remediation: Deploy runner checks `cert.target_system.environment === 'production'`.

attacks.attack_description: Modificación manual del archivo de Audit Trail.
attacks.attack_vector: Disk file alteration of AUD-GATE-xxx.json.
attacks.expected_result: Audit trail hash in certificate does not match tampered file content.
attacks.remediation: Audit trail reference and evidence hashes are anchored in the Release Certificate.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de modificar el objeto devuelto por getHistory() en la sesión de remediación.
attacks.attack_vector: Mutating child objects in array returned by getHistory().
attacks.expected_result: Deep cloning in getHistory() prevents memory mutation of internal session state.
attacks.remediation: Refactor getHistory() to return deep-cloned JSON serialization.

attacks.attack_description: Eliminación del archivo de sesión en .castle-remediation/ para ocultar deuda técnica.
attacks.attack_vector: File system deletion of active remediation ledger.
attacks.expected_result: Session load returns null; new evaluation triggers fresh session.
attacks.remediation: Store remediation ledgers in centralized append-only audit database in enterprise tier.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de añadir ciclos a una sesión de remediación ya cerrada (PASSED).
attacks.attack_vector: Calling recordCycle() on a closed RemediationSession.
attacks.expected_result: Exception thrown: Cannot add cycles to a closed session.
attacks.remediation: State machine blocks modifications to closed remediation sessions.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de ignorar el SLA de remediación vencido para autorizar release.
attacks.attack_vector: Submitting fixes after SLA deadline has expired.
attacks.expected_result: Store flags session as expired.
attacks.remediation: SLA expiration automatically requires re-authorization or escalation.

attacks.attack_description: Inyección de controles duplicados en el objeto de evidencia.
attacks.attack_vector: Duplicate JSON key collision in evidence payload.
attacks.expected_result: Standard ECMAScript JSON resolution evaluates cleanly without engine crash.
attacks.remediation: Evidence parser treats keys deterministically.

attacks.attack_description: Inyección de IDs de control inexistentes (ej. HACK-01.1, FAKE-99.9).
attacks.attack_vector: Injecting fake control keys to artificially manipulate evaluation.
attacks.expected_result: CQS Evaluator rejects payload containing unregistered control IDs.
attacks.remediation: CQS Evaluator validates every control ID strictly against official registry.

attacks.attack_description: Inyección de dominios no oficiales en required_domains de política.
attacks.attack_vector: Injecting non-existent domain codes into policy rules.
attacks.expected_result: Policy Validator identifies unknown domain code and marks valid = false.
attacks.remediation: Policy Validator validates domains strictly against domains.json.

attacks.attack_description: Inyección de valores NaN, Infinity, null o tipos corruptos en evidencia.
attacks.attack_vector: Injecting NaN, Infinity and null into control statuses.
attacks.expected_result: CQS evidence model rejects non-standard status values.
attacks.remediation: Strict enum status validation in evidence-model.js.

attacks.attack_description: Verificación de estabilidad de punto flotante en cálculo de 65 pesos atómicos.
attacks.attack_vector: Floating point rounding accumulation across 65 decimal weights.
attacks.expected_result: Total nominal weight equals 100.00 within machine epsilon (< 1e-12).
attacks.remediation: Scoring model uses IEEE 754 double precision arithmetic.

attacks.attack_description: Ejecución concurrente de múltiples evaluaciones independientes en paralelo.
attacks.attack_vector: Concurrent multi-threaded execution on same node process.
attacks.expected_result: State isolation maintained; zero cross-talk between evaluations.
attacks.remediation: Pure functional execution without global state mutation.

attacks.attack_description: Escritura simultánea de dos sesiones de remediación diferentes.
attacks.attack_vector: Concurrent filesystem writes to distinct session ledgers.
attacks.expected_result: Both session files persist cleanly without collision.
attacks.remediation: Session IDs use isolated filename partitioning.

attacks.attack_description: Emisión simultánea de dos certificados de release para diferentes commits.
attacks.attack_vector: Simultaneous certificate generation collision.
attacks.expected_result: Unique certificate IDs and distinct SHA-256 digests.
attacks.remediation: Certificates incorporate millisecond timestamps and unique payload digests.

attacks.attack_description: Envío de payload JSON malformado o truncado al CLI.
attacks.attack_vector: Malformed syntax injection into CLI file parser.
attacks.expected_result: Graceful catch returning exit code 3 without stack trace crash.
attacks.remediation: try/catch wrapping in bin.js.

attacks.attack_description: Envío de evidencia parcial (1 solo control) a evaluación C5 (que exige 65).
attacks.attack_vector: Sparse evidence injection at strict enterprise gate level.
attacks.expected_result: Gate blocks release and marks status as EVIDENCE_PENDING / REQUIRES_REMEDIATION.
attacks.remediation: `allow_unexecuted_controls: false` enforced on levels C3..C6.

attacks.attack_description: Eliminación de campos obligatorios del certificado emitido.
attacks.attack_vector: Stripping metrics_summary block from certificate.
attacks.expected_result: Verification fails due to canonical digest mismatch.
attacks.remediation: Certificate verification recalculates digest over all non-integrity keys.

attacks.attack_description: Alteración manual del campo policy_version en la decisión de Gate.
attacks.attack_vector: Spoofing policy_version inside release certificate.
attacks.expected_result: Digest check invalidates the tampered certificate.
attacks.remediation: Governance metadata is signed inside the SHA-256 certificate digest.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de forzar la ejecución con una propuesta no ratificada como si fuera oficial.
attacks.attack_vector: Passing PROPOSED policy matrix as custom policy override.
attacks.expected_result: Decision reflects governance_status as PROPOSED or CUSTOM_OVERRIDE.
attacks.remediation: Audit trail and release certificate record explicit policy governance status.

attacks.attack_description: Verificación de que CQS detecta cualquier modificación no autorizada en sus registros.
attacks.attack_vector: Tampering with CQS registry controls or domains.
attacks.expected_result: CQS Integrity Validator flags integrity as FAIL on registry modification.
attacks.remediation: cqs.validateCqsIntegrity() checks 65 controls and 7 domains against frozen manifest.

attacks.attack_description: Intento de sustituir el modelo de scoring de CQS por una fórmula externa no autorizada.
attacks.attack_vector: Injecting rogue scoring evaluator into Castle Gate pipeline.
attacks.expected_result: Gate tightly imports and evaluates through frozen cqs module.
attacks.remediation: Unified entrypoint imports cqs directly without dynamic plugin loading.
